title: Stock Market News Scraper input
description: Collect stock market news from Bloomberg, MarketWatch, CNBC, Yahoo Finance, Economic Times, Mint, and crypto outlets, or search Google News for any company, topic, or country. Filter by ticker or keyword, enrich with sentiment and event types, and return only new articles on scheduled runs.

feedPreset.title: Feed preset
feedPreset.description: Curated RSS feed bundle. Use "none" to fetch only search queries and ticker feeds, or "custom" to supply your own RSS URLs.
enumTitles: Earnings focus (CNBC Earnings, CNBC Investing, Bloomberg)
None (search queries and ticker feeds only)
feedPreset.sectionDescription: Pick a preset, search Google News, or provide your own RSS/Atom URLs. Sources are combined.

searchQueries.title: Google News search queries
searchQueries.description: Search Google News for any company, topic, or person (max 10), e.g. "Apple OR AAPL", "Reliance Industries", "lithium prices". Combined with the preset. Google News operators like OR, quotes, site:, and when:7d work. Article links point to Google News redirect URLs.

searchLanguage.title: Search language
searchLanguage.description: Two-letter language code for Google News searches (e.g. en, hi, de, ja).

searchCountry.title: Search country
searchCountry.description: Two-letter country code for Google News searches (e.g. US, IN, GB, DE, JP).

feeds.title: Custom feeds
feeds.description: RSS or Atom feed URLs (http or https only, max 20). Used only when Feed preset is "custom". Each item can be a URL string or an object with name and url.

tickers.title: Stock tickers
tickers.description: Only include articles about these tickers (e.g. AAPL, TSLA, NVDA, RELIANCE.NS). Each ticker also fetches its Yahoo Finance headline feed (max 20), and well-known company names (Apple, Nvidia, Infosys, ...) count as a match. Leave empty to disable the ticker filter.
tickers.sectionDescription: Narrow results by ticker, company name, keywords, or date. Search query results skip ticker and company filters.

useTickerFeeds.title: Fetch per-ticker feeds
useTickerFeeds.description: When tickers are set, also fetch each ticker's Yahoo Finance headline feed. Turn off to filter only the preset or custom feeds.

companies.title: Company names
companies.description: Only include articles mentioning these company names. Leave empty to disable.

tickerMatchMode.title: Ticker match mode
tickerMatchMode.description: When multiple tickers are set: "any" keeps articles matching at least one ticker; "all" requires every ticker.

includeKeywords.title: Include keywords
includeKeywords.description: Only include articles where the headline or summary contains at least one keyword. Leave unset to use built-in finance keywords (stock, market, earnings, S&P, Dow, Nasdaq, ...), which apply only to the US, global, earnings, and custom presets when no tickers, companies, or search queries are set. Use [] to disable keyword filtering; an explicit list is always applied.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Exclude articles where the headline or summary contains any of these keywords.

hoursBack.title: Hours back
hoursBack.description: Only include articles published within this many hours. Use 0 to disable the date filter.

maxItems.title: Maximum items
maxItems.description: Maximum news items returned after sorting by publishedDate descending. Runs also stop at your maximum cost per run.
maxItems.sectionDescription: How many articles to return, scheduled-run behavior, and enrichment.

maxItemsPerFeed.title: Max items per feed
maxItemsPerFeed.description: Optional cap on items kept from each individual feed before global sorting. Leave empty for no per-feed limit.

onlyNewArticles.title: Only new articles
onlyNewArticles.description: Skip articles already returned by earlier runs with the same sources and filters. Ideal for scheduled alerts: you only receive (and pay for) new headlines. History is kept for 14 days in a named key-value store.

stateKey.title: History key
stateKey.description: Optional name for the onlyNewArticles history. Runs sharing a key share history, even if their filters differ. Leave empty to derive it from sources and filters.

enrichArticles.title: Enrich articles
enrichArticles.description: Add companyDetails (name, exchange, sector), eventTypes (earnings, M&A, analyst ratings, ...), sentimentScore, and sentimentLabel to each article.

includeFullText.title: Include full article text
includeFullText.description: Fetch each returned article page and extract the readable body text. Skips paywalled publishers (Bloomberg, WSJ, FT, Barron's) and Google News redirect links. Makes runs slower.

fullTextMaxChars.title: Full text max characters
fullTextMaxChars.description: Truncate extracted article text to this many characters.

deduplicate.title: Deduplicate by link
deduplicate.description: Remove duplicate articles that appear in multiple feeds.
deduplicate.sectionDescription: Deduplication, network settings, and failure handling.

requestTimeoutMs.title: Request timeout (ms)
requestTimeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout per feed or article request.

feedRetries.title: Feed retries
feedRetries.description: Number of retries after the first failed attempt for each feed.

failOnAllFeedsFailed.title: Fail run when all feeds fail
failOnAllFeedsFailed.description: Mark the run as FAILED (instead of succeeded with runStatus all_feeds_failed or error) so Apify monitoring and webhooks alert you.
